official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: PitchHighway turns a song you love into a practice journey with real-time pitch feedback. This plugin lets you ask about your own practice: your measured vocal range, your songs and how they fit your voice, your recent attempts, and note-level pitch reports from your runs. It only reads data from the PitchHighway account you connect, and it never exposes audio.

limitations_ja: 連携アカウントの練習データを読み取る。説明では音声そのものは公開しない。
